usage: Private local mod using the user's installed game. These assets are copyrighted game content, not newly licensed or redistributable artwork.

sprites.spr_dodgeheart_centered_white: SOUL, player indicators and menu cursor; centered original white sprite tinted per player
sprites.spr_diamondbullet: Rajada, Ricochete, Orbita, Costura path shots, reflector, hit particles and mouse target indicator
sprites.spr_smallbullet: Guided Cometa, mine, Pulso rings, Jardim seeds and opening previews
sprites.spr_spadebullet: Muralha, Pinca crossfire, Bumerangue, wall projectiles and warnings
sprites.spr_battlebg_stretch: Original battle-frame and clickable panels using native nine-slice stretched drawing

edits: No imported or generated replacement artwork. Sprites are referenced from the existing archive, with runtime tinting/scaling/mirroring. Character animations are display-only; collision still uses the PvP prototype's circular hitboxes.
